links.evidence: We are delivering the Flyer 60 and Flyer 72 to U.S. Special Operations Command for the Internally Transportable Vehicle (ITV) and Ground Mobility Vehicle (GMV) programs.
Our pharmaceutical distribution contract with Express Scripts, Inc. ("Express Scripts") on September 30, 2012 ($2.0 billion).
Sales to ASUSTeK Computer Inc. accounted for 12% of our total revenue for fiscal year 2017
our customer Rite Aid Corporation (including certain of its subsidiaries, “Rite Aid”)
During 2023, Lightsource BP was the only customer that accounted for 10% or more of our modules business net sales
Sales through our largest distributor, Tech Data Corporation and its affiliates, accounted for 23% , 17% and 16% of our net revenue for fiscal years 2013 , 2012 and 2011 , respectively.
Diamond Offshore accounted for 19.7%, 20.0% and 21.8% of our consolidated total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2014, 2013 and 2012.
Ingram Micro accounted for 10% of our total net revenue for both fiscal 2021 and 2020, respectively
We are upgrading Duro tactical vehicles for the Swiss Army through 2022
we began delivering Eagle armored patrol vehicles to the Danish Army in 2018.
In Q3 2023, we announced that a large AI supercomputer would be built entirely on Intel Xeon processors and 4,000 Intel Gaudi 2 AI hardware accelerators, with Stability AI as the anchor customer.
We perform work on a number of contracts with the Department of Defense and other agencies and departments of the U.S. Government including sub-contracts with government prime contractors.
